scope.description: Full 13-frame front_r sword grip cycle evaluation

accounting.pixellab_note: 0 chamadas PixelLab de produção nesta revisão; custo LLM não informado

contract1_bodyPreservation.details: All 13 frames have exactly 0 RGBA pixel delta against parent body (combat/qa5-repair1/front_r/Sword/layers/body/). Coreography and durations match exactly [30, 65, 35, 50, 45, 65, 35, 35, 100, 55, 80, 45, 90] ms = 730 ms.

contract2_gloveAndGripAnatomy.details: All 9 armed frames (F02..F10) display genuine handFront glove pixels traced directly over the real underlying hand/wrist. Zero geometric stamps, zero invented extra fingers, zero synthetic sockets. Pommel and crossguard are visible and correctly occluded by the palm.

contract3_reusedKeyframesIntegrity.details: F02, F06, and F08 are 100% byte-identical across all four layers (weaponBack, body, weaponFront, handFront) and composite PNGs to the validated representative studies (characters/orc-v1/source/combat-rescue-v5/grip-specialist/{F02,F06,F08}). No regression or anatomical torsion introduced.

contract4_visibleIntervalAndBookends.details: visibleInterval is strictly [2, 10]. Bookends F00, F01, F11, F12 have exactly 0 non-transparent pixels in weaponBack, weaponFront, and handFront layers. Composites 00, 01, 11, 12 are 100% byte-identical to the unarmed body.

contract5_itemLegibilityAndArc.details: Diagonal sword slash arc follows monotonic unwrapped angle progression [320°, 340°, 350°, 360°, 392°, 440°, 488°, 478°, 460°]. Blade lowest point in F08 reaches Y=185, maintaining a 5px safety margin above groundY=190. Sword features (edge highlights, fuller, hilt) remain legible at native 128 and tactical 64 scale.

contract6_mastersVerification.details: All four canonical Aseprite masters verified on disk with exact declared SHA-256 hashes: composite.aseprite (3ee5755c...), body.aseprite (b85c18f3...), native.aseprite (8fab269d...), hand.aseprite (d2c6a911...). Native 128 crop is confirmed as a body-centering window; full sword geometry is completely unclipped in the canonical 256x256 composite canvas.

frameByFrameAudit.visualObservation: Unarmed neutral resting pose; both arms hanging naturally; equipment layers completely empty.
Unarmed anticipation shift; right shoulder begins rise; equipment layers completely empty.
Reused keyframe F02 (byte-identical). Low right glove holds hilt angled diagonally up-left (320°); crossguard above, pommel below; left hand relaxed at hip.
Foreshortened brown glove raises sword in front of chest; hilt securely held at [90, 119]; steel cuff outlines wrist base; angle 340°.
Curled glove near right pauldron; dark aperture corresponds to inner glove shadow; blade points almost vertically (350°); forearm approaches from below-left.
High fist at apex [98, 89]; blade points straight vertical (360°/0°) into open space above; hilt firmly enclosed below crossguard.
Reused keyframe F06 (byte-identical). Powerful diagonal slash crosses chest; active right arm extends into glove [155, 114]; left hip hand remains inactive.
Contact impact frame; active forearm crosses chest; glove [158, 132] extends blade horizontally to the right (80°); pommel overlaps forearm cuff cleanly without gap.
Reused keyframe F08 (byte-identical). Low active glove holds sword below crossing forearm; angle 128° (488°); blade lowest Y=185 maintains 5px margin above groundY=190.
Active glove retracts toward center [134, 147] below steel cuff; wrist reverses smoothly to 118° (478°); opposite left fist remains inactive.
Dark glove settles low [110, 150] under hanging bracer, left of red tasset; blade held low at 100° (460°) well above ground.
Unarmed release frame; equipment and handFront completely empty; parent body preserved.
Final unarmed guard pose; perfectly matches one-shot terminal state; zero equipment pixels.

limitations: Inspection conducted through discrete still frames, strips, layer separations, and 8x diagnostic crops.
Functional Chromium playback verified 730ms / 1460ms wall-clock timings, one-shot stop at F12, and 1x/0.5x stepping.
Perceptual experience of continuous fluid motion in live game engine runtime remains the prerogative of the creator.
Scope is strictly limited to front_r/Sword; does not automatically approve the 28-cell matrix or Unity integration.
